fly_graph_completion.permitted_inputs: Known incoming connections; whole hidden outgoing profiles removed before feature construction. No hidden axon geometry, genes or target labels used as query inputs.
fly_graph_completion.scope: Within-specimen development on FlyWire v630; no independent-animal validation. AP is average precision, not percent accuracy.

fly_mouse_transfer.biological_transfer: No fly cell identities, anatomical edges or neurotransmitter signs are copied into mouse biology.
fly_mouse_transfer.finding: Direct frozen fly parameter transfer performs worse than mouse-only training. A fly-informed slope prior has only a tiny descriptive gain over mouse-only shared_input_logistic: AP about +0.52% relative; log loss about -0.017%; Brier about -0.018%.
fly_mouse_transfer.scope: Nonblind development on one mouse, retaining metadata-defined isolated neurons. No hypothalamic or independent-animal transfer claim.

limits: No complete hypothalamic circuit reconstruction or new validated 3D axon predictor is established here.
These data do not demonstrate gas-vesicle-mediated lifespan extension, aging reversal or clinical efficacy.
The full generated 3D viewer remains local because its measured trace licences restrict redistribution.
This summary does not distribute raw papers, raw synapse data or licensed neuron geometry.

map.counts_meaning: Evidence links include paired intervention-target and intervention-outcome records. They are not independent observations or synapses.
map.curation_status: All literature records remain unreviewed; source fidelity was independently audited.
map.placement: Mouse region meshes only; no study population is assigned to an example traced neuron. Rat, unknown-species and fly anatomy are not placed in the mouse scene.

next_scientific_requirements: Review individual source assertions and retain study-specific controls, animal identities and uncertainty.
Evaluate any functional predictor on held-out intervention outcomes and independent studies or animals, with simple controls.
Establish same-system connection and functional response measurements before interpreting an anatomical path as a predictable intervention outcome.

source_studies.scope: Published mouse LH-to-VTA mechanogenetic circuit evidence; no aging or lifespan endpoint. Functional evidence is not relabeled as identified synapses.

Published chemogenetic DMH Ppp1r17 lifespan result in males, n=13 per group, log-rank p=0.0406. Chemogenetic rather than GV/ultrasound; lifespan animals were separate from the physiological-assay cohorts. No gas-vesicle longevity result.
